# Tendriller

> Build a session-connected web application from a user's request. Tendriller hosts authenticated UI, signed controls, and account-linked `/mcp`; one owned Chronolog session supplies durable commands, queries, events, live signals, and peer replication.

## Start here, in order

- [Build an app](https://tendriller.dev/docs/BUILD_AN_APP.md): complete first application in an agent workspace; register the agent → create a page → choose finality policy (default none) and define state → prepare publisher policy and publish the signed UI → owner sign-in → browser initializes its own root and keys locally → add devices explicitly → verify.
- [Capability map](https://tendriller.dev/docs/CAPABILITIES.md): task keywords mapped to Chronolog, session, UI, camera, voice, inference, and preview APIs.
- [Sensors and agent-requested observations](https://tendriller.dev/docs/SENSORS.md): filtered capability inspection, cooperative resource lifecycle, runnable location/motion/instrument/media examples, and local consent.
- [Deliver the running app](https://tendriller.dev/docs/AGENT_DELIVERY.md): provision early, publish before claim, give the owner the ready page URL, and verify browser-local durable writes, offline authoring, convergence and any optional process lifetime/resume details.
- [Download the first app](https://tendriller.dev/downloads/tendriller-first-app.tgz): starter source files; follow the build guide for the verified `firstApp.release` package kit.
- [Reusable application patterns](https://tendriller.dev/docs/APP_PATTERNS.md): `createLiveView`, operation tracking, connection UX, and reviewed input over the real session.
- [Agent requests and receipts](https://tendriller.dev/docs/AGENT_REQUESTS.md): worker-owned ephemeral presence, full request references, timestamps, durable receipts and answers.
- [Same-conversation delivery](https://tendriller.dev/docs/CONVERSATION_DELIVERY.md): inspect the actual host mechanism, inject requests into an active Codex turn, retain per-page handled cursors and qualify idle wake across turn completion.
- [Restart consumers](https://tendriller.dev/docs/AGENT_RESTART.md): what survives a republish, and what to re-arm after an agent program restart.
- [Reviewed media and inference](https://tendriller.dev/docs/AI_INPUT.md): camera/file or voice capture, credential-owning native inference, editable review, and explicit command commit.
- [Events or SQL](https://tendriller.dev/docs/STATE_MODELS.md): events vs. guarded SQL transactions and required engine artifacts.
- [Preview early](https://tendriller.dev/docs/tools/PREVIEW.md): static authored-file preview vs. explicitly composed real-session preview.
- [Session bootstrap](https://tendriller.dev/docs/SESSION_BOOTSTRAP.md): persistent device identity, browser-first root initialization, recipient-bound key provisioning for additional devices, and safe resume.
- [Multi-participant composition](https://tendriller.dev/docs/MULTIPARTICIPANT.md): shared profile owners, addressed work, exclusive claims, independent drafts, and recovery.
- [Multi-page agents](https://tendriller.dev/docs/MULTI_PAGE_AGENTS.md): one agent, one credential and one signing key for many pages; workspace layout, grants, hub and `tendril agent run`.
- [Agents and grants](https://tendriller.dev/docs/AGENT_BINDINGS.md): agent credentials, dashboard join codes, per-page grants, scopes and revocation.
- [Outbound OAuth & org access](https://tendriller.dev/docs/OAUTH_CONNECTIONS.md): Tier A zero-trust (`agent-held`) and Tier B wrapped (`host-brokered`, personal & shared team) third-party OAuth connections across 15 built-in providers + BYO OAuth 2.1, plus GitHub Org/Team & Google Workspace admission and seamless offboarding.
- [Agent guide](https://tendriller.dev/agent.md): concise workflow, ownership boundaries, and reference snippets.
- [MCP agent start](https://tendriller.dev/docs/MCP_AGENT_GUIDE.md): `tendril_guide`, account-linked agent registration (`register_agent`), and connecting existing apps.
- [ChatGPT integration](https://tendriller.dev/docs/CHATGPT_INTEGRATION.md#agent-walkthrough): plugin install, workspace sharing, account linking, per-app consent, and event delivery.
- [Troubleshooting](https://tendriller.dev/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): failing stages, safe retries, and exact next actions.
- [Test a release locally](https://tendriller.dev/docs/LOCAL_HOST.md): verified packed host, synthetic owner, and register/create/init/publish/pair/connect before production.

Page creation or package installation alone is not completion. Verify a locally stored and materialized (revisable) operation, independent offline authoring, automatic convergence with another participant, persistence after reload, and the signed publication receipt. A native participant or the agent program is optional, never a prerequisite for ordinary browser reads or durable saves. Keep private identity, keys, and exact operation IDs outside published UI.

## Discovery and access

- [Machine-readable onboarding](https://tendriller.dev/.well-known/tendriller.json): same-origin entry points, lifecycle, and `firstApp.release` kit.
- [Capability manifest](https://tendriller.dev/.well-known/tendriller-capabilities.json): searchable task vocabulary, imports, owners, and limits.
- [Full onboarding text](https://tendriller.dev/llms-full.txt): generated single-fetch combined onboarding guide.
- [Service descriptor](https://tendriller.dev/api/service): host contract, release, and effective limits.
- [Service readiness](https://tendriller.dev/api/readiness): anonymous pre-installation creation and write availability check.
- [Contract schema](https://tendriller.dev/contract/v3.json): executable host metadata schema.
- [Repository agent entry](https://tendriller.dev/AGENTS.md): app-building and repository contribution rules.

## Reference

- [Architecture](https://tendriller.dev/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Chronolog central pipe, limited transports, and package boundaries.
- [Application contract](https://tendriller.dev/docs/APPLICATION_BACKENDS.md): commands, saved/applied operations, coherent reads, and explicit recovery.
- [Browser API](https://tendriller.dev/docs/BROWSER_API.md): session adapter, sensors, Home Screen setup, and offline code.
- [Membership](https://tendriller.dev/docs/MEMBERSHIP.md): independent account, device, and publisher rights.
- [Peer connections](https://tendriller.dev/docs/PEER_CONNECTIONS.md): discovery, invitations, direct WebRTC, and relay fallback.
- [WebRTC media, custom streams & calls](https://tendriller.dev/docs/WEBRTC_MEDIA.md): video/audio calls, in-band Perfect Negotiation, custom `app:*` binary DataChannels, continuous on-device per-person transcripts, and agent call following.
- [Protocol](https://tendriller.dev/docs/PROTOCOL.md): filtered control transport, authorization, and release atomicity.
- [Cloudflare assistant](https://tendriller.dev/docs/CLOUDFLARE_ASSISTANT.md): hosted `/mcp` gateway, hibernating participant sockets, and event delivery.
- [Live signals](https://tendriller.dev/docs/APPLICATION_SIGNALS.md): ephemeral delivery, expiration, and cancellation.
- [Voice](https://tendriller.dev/docs/HANDS_FREE.md): optional browser speech input/output.

## Tools, examples, and verification

- [Deployment](https://tendriller.dev/docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md): choose a host for `tendril agent run`, its process lifetime and resume route.
- [Pricing, quotas, and plans](https://tendriller.dev/docs/PRICING.md): Free, Pro, Team, and unlimited Self-Hosted tiers, PAYG spend caps, live headroom inspection, and `quota_exceeded` handling.
- [Changelog and sunsetting policy](https://tendriller.dev/docs/CHANGELOG.md): notable new features, deprecations/sunsets, breaking upgrades, and security advisories (also `/api/changelog` and `tendril changelog` for fallow workspaces).
- [Self-hosting](https://tendriller.dev/docs/SELF_HOSTING.md): run your own Tendriller on Cloudflare in 5 minutes with unlimited quotas and zero lock-in.
- [Request-driven hosting](https://tendriller.dev/docs/SERVERLESS_HOST.md): explicit storage-owner serialization, authorization and bounded execution.

- [CLI](https://tendriller.dev/docs/tools/CLI.md): `tendril guide --server URL`, `tendril service --server URL`, the agent workspace (`workspace`, `page`, `agent run`), and session inspection.
- [Preview](https://tendriller.dev/docs/tools/PREVIEW.md): static and live authored-file preview.
- [Releases](https://github.com/werg/tendriller/releases): SDK, runtime, tools, and first-app kit archives.
- [Chronolog](https://github.com/werg/chronolog-db): native/browser session implementation and package builder.
- [Cookbooks](https://github.com/werg/tendriller-contrib): application patterns, larger examples, and independent qualification.
- [Requested observation reference](https://tendriller.dev/docs/OBSERVATION_REFERENCE.md): browser/native simulation and location, correlated replies, durable review/retry and a real Worker qualifier.
- [Cold-start acceptance](https://tendriller.dev/docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING_TEST.md): domain-only agent evaluation.

Use the requested service origin throughout. Application identity is `{id}`; device signing identity is `session.deviceId`.
